transformations: For each l1/l2 group, sum complete_seconds for each method over both queries and seeds.
Normalize that sum by exact right-first sum on the same group (ratio of pooled costs).
No confidence interval or significance claim; seeds are repetitions of related queries.
panel_b.scope: Actual paid single-slot Qwen inference plus audit, planning, bookkeeping and returned SQL; reference acquisition/validation, startup and warmup excluded. This is not replay latency.

caption_stub: (a) Archived Llama-3.3-70B fixed-label replay: all 32 initial-cache cells from 16 related native DBpedia queries, audit budgets 125/500 per side and seed 101. The x coordinate is max(0, G_joint - floor(U_separate)), a proved lower bound on extra certifiable initial discards; x = 0 is inconclusive, not equality. The y coordinate counts complete paid requests saved by joint versus separate greedy. Circles/squares denote l1/l2; hollow/solid markers denote audits 125/500. A cardinality advantage need not reduce adaptive requests. (b) Fresh Qwen2.5-7B Q4_K_M actual paid-label closed loop: all four related native queries, four methods and seeds 101/202 (32 measured runs). Bars are pooled complete seconds divided by pooled exact right-first seconds within each l1/l2 group. Cost includes real paid inference, audit, planning, bookkeeping and returned-first SQL; reference construction/validation, startup and warmup are excluded. The resident single-slot oracle executes logical batches serially. The panels use distinct oracles; seeds are repeated audits, not independent workloads.

design.panel_a_encodings: All points navy; circle=l1, square=l2; hollow=125/side, solid=500/side.
design.panel_b_encodings: Zero-based bars; white Exact, gray // Per-side, green backslash Separate, navy dots Joint.
design.uncertainty: None drawn. Related queries and repeated audit seeds do not provide independent replications.

alt_text: All 32 native certificate cells plot a proved lower bound on extra initial discards against complete requests saved. Some positive cardinality gains increase requests; zero x is inconclusive. The second panel compares pooled actual complete latency with exact right-first, separately for coarse and fine keys, on four related native queries with two audit seeds each.
